notes: Hotfix after live universal-AI tests. AUTO now explicitly clears legacy AI_TURNED_OFF so old Xanos saves can re-arm. PREBUFF/FULLBUFF starts a companion-local resume watchdog that cancels on visible enemies and clears stale prebuff/action locks after the spell queue ends, preventing Dorna from remaining idle after buffing. Manual panel close is sticky until the player explicitly clicks a real henchman portrait; background init no longer recreates the main panel. Buff icons are right-aligned in a strip ending beside the selected companion portrait. PRC PnP familiar class progression repair: the familiar UTCs are Commoner class 20 but have StartingPackage 151 (empty Hexblade1 package), which is why stock LevelUpHenchman(CLASS_TYPE_INVALID) fails; the guard now advances Bain Kai's Wizard/Sorcerer-based familiar levels using class 20 with valid Commoner package 82. PRC stat scaling remains untouched.
